title: Technology for Good
description:
We are excited to host our next in-person event at HENNGE!
WiSE JP is focused on empowering diverse women in Japan to succeed in technology careers. Technology for Good brings together engineering stories from projects addressing meaningful real-world challenges.
Through deep-dive talks and community lightning talks, speakers will take us behind the technology: the problems they set out to solve, what they built, the technical decisions and trade-offs they encountered, and what they learned alon…
address: Daiwa Shibuya Square, 16-28 Nanpeidai-cho, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
